description: Create a comprehensive CONTRIBUTING.md file that documents how to contribute to the project: adding new projects, translating content, code conventions, development setup, and PR workflow.
steps: Create CONTRIBUTING.md at the project root with the following sections:
Section 1 - Introduction: Brief welcome, project purpose, link to README.
Section 2 - Development Setup: Prerequisites (Node.js 18+, pnpm), clone instructions, pnpm install, pnpm dev, open localhost:3000/vi or /en.

Section 3 - Adding a New Project: Step-by-step guide to add an entry to data/projects.ts. Document the Project type fields, where to find icon URLs (homarr-labs/dashboard-icons), how to write bilingual content, score guidelines, deploy snippet format.
Section 4 - Adding a Category: How to add to the categories array, slug naming convention, bilingual title/description.
Section 5 - Adding a Use Case (Alternative): How to add to useCases array, linking projectSlugs.
Section 6 - Translation Guidelines: How bilingual content works (Record<Locale, string>), writing natural Vietnamese vs English, maintaining parity between languages.
Section 7 - Code Conventions: TypeScript strict mode, no external UI libraries (plain CSS), component naming (kebab-case files, PascalCase exports), using @/ path aliases.
Section 8 - Pull Request Process: Branch naming, commit message format, run pnpm lint + pnpm build before submitting, describe changes clearly.
Section 9 - Project Submission via Web: Mention the /submit-project form as an alternative for non-developers.
Write the document bilingually or primarily in English with Vietnamese section headers/notes where helpful for the target audience.
acceptance_criteria: Document covers: dev setup, adding projects, adding categories, adding use cases, translation guidelines, code conventions, PR process
Document includes concrete examples (e.g., a minimal project entry template)
Document references actual file paths and commands used in the project
verification: Confirm CONTRIBUTING.md exists and is well-formatted markdown
Run pnpm build to ensure no regressions
